definition: I. [ נַעֲמָן ] noun [masculine] usually pleasantness (so Thes amoenitas ), but perhaps epithet of Adonis (so Mo Phoen. i. 227 Lag Symm. i. 468; Semit. i. 32 who compare red flower called [see Lane 1578 ], i.e. wound of Adonis , whence ἀνεμώη ; compare Ew Proph. i. 364 RS Proph. vi. n. 10 and see Lewy Fremdwörter, 49 ); — only plural נִטְעֵי נַעֲמָנִים Isa 17:10 ( ᵐ5 φύτευμα ἄπιστον ) perhaps = Adonis-plantations , or gardens (on double plural see Ges «GKC:124q»§ 124q ; and on Ἀδώνιδος κῆποι see Rochette Rev. Archéol. viii. 1851, 105-123 Daremberg et Saglio Dict. des Antiquités (1877), i. 73, and references W Smith Dict. Antiq. (3) i. 25 Fl in Levy NHWB iv. 229 ).
